headline: Sanctum Infinity core addresses identified; GitHub repository located but program IDs require on-chain read

findings.text: Solana explorer pages returned JavaScript-heavy markup without renderable address details; explorer name-tag search not directly accessible via fetch. Core addresses (INF token mint, Infinity stake pool) identified from documentation blog posts and market data sites.

Deployed contracts documentation page at learn.sanctum.so returned fetch error; alternative doc sources (blog posts, DeFiLlama) confirm INF token address 5oVNBeEEQvYi1cX3ir8Dx5n1P7pdxydbGF2X4TxVusJm and Infinity Pool address 5oc4nmbNTda9fx8Tw57ShLD132aqDK65vuHH4RU1K4LZ.
No audit links provided in per-protocol context. Technical documentation references three independent audits but does not list audit firm names or report URLs in accessible sources.

GitHub organization https://github.com/igneous-labs identified; inf-1.5 repository noted as current Infinity program development location. Direct fetch of GitHub repos blocked by allowlist. Repository listing shows 86+ repos but specific program IDs and deployment artifacts not enumerable without on-chain read or browse-based access.
Protocol is Solana-only (single chain); no cross-chain enumeration required.

Infinity is not a factory; it is a multi-LST liquidity pool. LST integration is curated via whitelist rather than factory enumeration. Sanctum LST list maintained at https://github.com/igneous-labs/sanctum-lst-list but 1000+ integrated LSTs exceed discovery cap; recorded as reference only.

Addresses identified carry roles: INF (token/pool LP token), Infinity stake pool (pool). Admin, fee beneficiary, and rebalance authority addresses documented as fields within Pool State PDA but specific signer addresses not accessible without on-chain read.
Addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to fetched blogs and market data. Program IDs (S Controller, Pricing Program, etc.) referenced in documentation but not yet enumerated as concrete addresses.

rationale.verdict: Grade is unknown because address discovery for Solana programs requires on-chain reads (either via Solana explorer API or defipunkd read API) to extract program IDs from transaction introspection or account data. Fetched website and docs confirm the protocol exists and identify two token/pool addresses; GitHub org is located but program IDs are not discoverable without on-chain inspection. D2, D3 checklist items partially unmet. Downstream slices (control, exit, autonomy, verifiability) will inherit these two addresses and will need to perform on-chain reads to discover the full set of program and authority accounts.

evidence.shows: Sanctum homepage confirms protocol name, chains (Solana), category (LST/staking infrastructure), and lists Infinity as flagship product. Links to app.sanctum.so, learn.sanctum.so docs, and https://github.com/igneous-labs GitHub org.

Blog post documenting Infinity launch and confirming INF Token Address: 5oVNBeEEQvYi1cX3ir8Dx5n1P7pdxydbGF2X4TxVusJm and Explorer Link: https://solana.fm/address/5oVNBeEEQvYi1cX3ir8Dx5n1P7pdxydbGF2X4TxVusJm. Notes migration from scnSOL to INF.

Solana Compass pool statistics page confirms Infinity stake pool address 5oc4nmbNTda9fx8Tw57ShLD132aqDK65vuHH4RU1K4LZ and reiterates INF Pool Token address 5oVNBeEEQvYi1cX3ir8Dx5n1P7pdxydbGF2X4TxVusJm. Documents pool reserves, staking behavior, and fee structure.

Technical documentation describes Pool State PDA (derived seed 'state'), LST State List PDA (seed 'lst-state-list'), S Controller program, Pricing Program, Flat Fee Pricing Program, and LST Reserve ATAs. Notes admin, fee beneficiary, rebalance authority as stored in Pool State. States Infinity has been audited by three independent firms but does not list firm names or report URLs in this excerpt.

GitHub organization page for Igneous Labs (Sanctum's development team). Lists 86+ repositories including inf-1.5 (current Infinity development), sanctum-spl-stake-pool, sanctum-lst-list, and other SDKs and tools.
Repository defining definitive list of Liquid Staking Tokens integrated under Sanctum. Confirms 1000+ LST integrations via curated whitelist rather than factory pattern.

Sanctum blog post detailing Infinity mechanics: multi-LST liquidity pool holding basket of LSTs, earning staking yields and trading fees. Mentions Infinity has facilitated 9.6M SOL trades, secured 2M SOL during Wonderland campaign, and passed audits by three independent firms (firm names and dates not listed).

Sanctum project overview confirming Infinity is a multi-LST liquidity pool and core component. Describes S Controller as central program managing LST reserves, updates, swaps, deposits, withdrawals, and rebalancing.

unknowns: D2-offchain: Deployed contracts documentation page at https://learn.sanctum.so/docs/deployments or similar could not be fetched; alternative sources (blogs, DeFiLlama) confirm two core addresses but do not enumerate full program ID set.

D3: No audit links provided in per-protocol context; blog posts reference three independent audits but do not name firms or link reports. Audit search deferred to evaluation slices with access to on-chain ABIs.

D4: GitHub repository inf-1.5 location confirmed but cannot enumerate specific program IDs, buffer accounts, or deployment artifacts without browse-based GitHub access or cloned git history inspection.

D6: Sanctum LST list repository confirmed (1361+ integrated LSTs per docs) but cap at 50 per D6 checklist means enumerating LST children requires on-chain factory-pattern read, which does not apply; Infinity is curated whitelist not factory.

D8: Program IDs (S Controller, Pricing Program, Flat Fee Pricing Program, SOL value calculator programs) documented in technical spec but not yet bound to concrete Solana addresses; on-chain read of Pool State PDA will surface these.

D1-onchain: Solana explorer pages (explorer.solana.com, solana.fm) returned JavaScript-heavy responses without renderableaddress details; Solana mainnet name-tag search not directly callable via fetch.

protocol_metadata.about: Sanctum is Solana's leading liquid staking infrastructure protocol. Infinity, its flagship product, is a multi-LST liquidity pool that accepts deposits of various liquid staking tokens and enables efficient swaps between LSTs with minimal slippage. Users deposit SOL or whitelisted LSTs to receive INF tokens representing their share of the pool's diversified staking yield. The protocol manages a curated list of 1000+ integrated LSTs and provides staking-as-a-service infrastructure for partners.
